name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as a keycap in help text, menus and tooltips.

when: Telling people which key or shortcut does something.

instead.when: The label is a status, not a key.
Code or a value is shown, not a key to press.

builtIn: Kbd isModifier shows ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere.
youProvide: A `label` for glyph keys a screen reader may skip ("Command" for ⌘).

Kbd.name: children
Kbd.description: One key per Kbd; a shortcut is several Kbd separated by a space. Left out with `isModifier`.

Kbd.name: isModifier
Kbd.description: The platform's shortcut modifier: ⌘ on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere (Ctrl on the server, settled after mount).

Kbd.name: label
Kbd.description: What a screen reader says instead of a glyph it may skip ("Command" for ⌘); the glyph is then hidden.
